    Modifier and Type
    Method
    Description
    void
    BuildingCardPickedDelta.applyTo(ClientModel model)
    Applies the pick to the client model: adds the building to the player, refreshes the showed building rows, updates the player's food and prestige points, returns the totem if needed and sets the current phase.
    void
    CharacterCardPickedDelta.applyTo(ClientModel model)
    Applies the pick to the client model: adds the card to the player's tribe, refreshes the showed tribe rows, updates the player's food and prestige points, returns the totem if needed and sets the current phase.
    void
    EndGameDelta.applyTo(ClientModel model)
    Applies the end-game update to the client model: sets every player's prestige points to their final score, records the winner and marks the game as ended.
    void
    EndTurnDelta.applyTo(ClientModel model)
    Applies the end-of-turn update to the client model: refreshes the food and prestige points of every player, updates the showed tribe and building rows, advances the turn, phase and era, and registers any events triggered during the turn.
    abstract void
    GameDelta.applyTo(ClientModel model)
    Applies this delta to the given client model, mutating its local replica of the game state to reflect the change carried by the delta.
    void
    LeaderboardDelta.applyTo(ClientModel model)
    Applies the update to the client model by storing the final leaderboard.
    void
    OfferCardADelta.applyTo(ClientModel model)
    Applies the offer to the client model: returns the player's totem to the turn card and updates their food amount.
    void
    SkipDelta.applyTo(ClientModel model)
    Applies the skip to the client model: returns the player's totem if needed and sets the current phase.
    void
    TotemPlacedDelta.applyTo(ClientModel model)
    Applies the placement to the client model: updates the turn-card offer order, places the totem on the track tile and sets the current phase.
